---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new entity type, recognizer, or capability
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem
What PII type, format, or use case isn't handled well today? If possible, include example text (synthetic, no real PII) that should be detected.

## Proposed solution
Describe the approach — a new pattern, a new recognizer, a new entity type, an integration with an external library, etc.

## Alternatives considered
Other approaches you've thought about and why you ruled them out.

## Additional context
Links to reference specs (ISO standards, regulatory definitions), related issues, or prior art from other PII tools.
